title: Berry Yogurt Breakfast Bowl
subtitle: Creamy Greek Yogurt with Fresh Berries & Granola
description: Creamy Greek yogurt topped with fresh berries, crunchy granola, honey, and a sprinkle of chia seeds.

hero_image.alt: Greek yogurt bowl with berries and granola

introduction: A creamy, refreshing breakfast that takes just minutes to put together.
Greek yogurt adds protein while berries and granola bring freshness and crunch.

dos.title: Add Granola Last
dos.text: Add granola just before serving so it stays crunchy.

donts.title: Overload with Toppings
donts.text: Keep the toppings balanced so the yogurt remains the star.

instructions_overview: Add Greek yogurt to a bowl and top with berries, granola, honey, and chia seeds.

instructions: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with berries, granola, honey, and chia seeds.

general: Drink: Coffee, green tea, or fresh orange juice.
pairing_suggestions.summary: Fresh, creamy, and ready in five minutes.

title: Avocado & Egg Toast
subtitle: Sourdough Toast with Soft Scrambled Egg
description: Crispy sourdough topped with creamy avocado, soft scrambled egg, chili flakes, and fresh herbs.
introduction: A more filling take on classic avocado toast with creamy scrambled egg.
It is quick enough for breakfast but satisfying enough to keep you going.

dos.title: Cook Eggs Gently
dos.text: Low heat keeps scrambled eggs soft and creamy.

donts.title: Overcook the Eggs
donts.text: Remove them from heat while they still look slightly glossy.

instructions_overview: Toast the bread, mash the avocado, then top with gently scrambled eggs and seasonings.

instructions: Toast the sourdough and mash avocado with lemon juice.
Scramble eggs gently in olive oil until soft.
Top with scrambled egg, chili flakes, parsley, salt, and pepper.

general: Drink: Coffee or fresh orange juice.
pairing_suggestions.summary: Creamy, savory, and packed with protein.

title: Salmon & Avocado Rice Bowl
subtitle: Roasted Salmon with Rice, Avocado & Cucumber
description: Flaky roasted salmon served over rice with creamy avocado, cucumber, sesame, and lemon.
introduction: A colorful bowl combining tender salmon with fresh vegetables and fluffy rice.
A balanced option for lunch or dinner when you want something nourishing but substantial.

dos.title: Check the Center
dos.text: Cook salmon until the center flakes easily and reaches a safe internal temperature.

donts.title: Overcook the Salmon
donts.text: Avoid leaving salmon in the oven longer than necessary so it stays moist.

instructions_overview: Roast seasoned salmon, prepare rice and vegetables, then assemble everything into a bowl.

instructions: Season salmon with olive oil, lemon, salt, and pepper.
Roast until flaky and fully cooked.
Top with salmon, avocado, cucumber, sesame seeds, and lemon.

pairing_suggestions.summary: Fresh, colorful, and packed with satisfying protein.

title: Greek Chicken Pita
subtitle: Grilled Chicken with Tzatziki & Fresh Vegetables
description: Warm pita filled with seasoned chicken, crisp lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and creamy tzatziki.
introduction: A fresh Mediterranean-inspired meal with juicy chicken and crunchy vegetables.

dos.title: Warm the Pita
dos.text: Heating the pita briefly makes it softer and easier to fold.

donts.title: Add Too Much Sauce
donts.text: A moderate amount of tzatziki keeps the pita from becoming soggy.

instructions_overview: Season and cook the chicken, slice the vegetables, then fill warm pita bread with all ingredients.

instructions: Season chicken with oregano, salt, pepper, and olive oil.
Cook in a hot grill pan until golden and fully cooked.
Fill with lettuce, tomato, cucumber, chicken, and tzatziki.

general: Serve with sparkling water and lemon.
pairing_suggestions.summary: Fresh Mediterranean flavors in a convenient handheld meal.
